newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon's Solidere falls for fourth day.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon's Solidere falls for fourth day.

text.p: Solidere shares fell for the fourth consecutive day on Thursday. A shares fell 1.4 percent to $111.375 and B shares shed 1.8 percent to reach $115.
Turnover was 10,634 shares compared with 11,162 on Wednesday and value was $1,202,675.25 from $1,282,154.375.
Dealers say oversupply is pulling the shares down.
Thursday's offer was 21,182 A shares against demand of 2,376 and 12,627 B shares against demand of 5,317.
"There was a big supply in the market today. I do not think it is a trend, I expect the market will improve next week," a dealer told Reuters.
There was no trade in the four other companies listed on the Beirut Stock Exchange: Ciments Libanais, Ciments Blancs, Eternit and Uniceramic.
The LISPI stock index fell 0.47 percent to 81.38 and the BLOM stock index also fell 1.32 percent to 964.91.
